name: SHO-BOND Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: SHO-BOND Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in repairing and reinforcing social infrastructures in Japan. It operates through the Domestic Construction and Others segments. The company is involved in civil engineering and construction work contracting; and provision of repair and reinforcement services for roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, and buildings, as well as port and harbor facilities, water supply and sewer systems, and irrigation channels.
